d:
This is the new Pagani Huayra Codalunga Speedster. It’s the most powerful road-going Pagani ever, on par with the Pagani Utopia hypercar, thanks to a 852hp V12 from Mercedes-AMG – and, as a bonus, it’s mated to an open-gate manual gearbox! Those elements, plus the bespoke ‘longtail’ body and bespoke carbon and titanium chassis, push the cost of the limited run of ten cars to £11m each. This then, from the power to the price, via the intricately detailed interior with 4 million(!) stitches, is peak Pagani!
Pagani Huayra Codalunga Speedster
Ollie Kew
